newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent poised to firm on front month buying.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent poised to firm on front month buying.

text.p: August Brent crude futures were marginally softer in late trading on Thursday, but prices were expected to rise on good buying.
August Brent on SIMEX last traded $18.85 per barrel, down seven cents from London's close of $18.92.
But brokers said there was healthy buying interest in the front months, which will probably push levels higher.
"There has been resistance at $19.00, but this could be broken, maybe by today" said a broker.
NYMEX last traded at $20.25 for August, nine cents lower than New York's close, which has risen 22 cents to $20.34.
